sampling_scope: Pilot and final CLI modes both collect five measured observations per product/workload. Observe mode runs once; profile mode remains separate.
timing_scope: Coarse performance context; conditions are recorded, but observed concurrent builds or unavailable process observations do not block collection. No quiet-machine requirement.
pair_order: baseline then candidate on even attempt IDs; candidate then baseline on odd attempt IDs
invalid_pair_rule: Retain both runs with pair_valid=false, replace the whole pair with a new attempt ID and alternating order; never discard a slow valid run.
resource_guard: A peak RSS guard is evaluated from reaped child rusage and terminates the set when exceeded. It does not prevent a child from exceeding that amount before exit. An external interruption also terminates the set; neither is replaced.
median: ordinary median of all accepted samples for one build/workload/set
range: minimum and maximum of all accepted observations for one product/workload/set
p95: null with not-claimed status; lightweight observations do not establish percentile evidence
rerun: A new five-pair set with prior sets retained; do not combine different source, configuration, or binary identities.
collector: os.wait4 direct child rusage; Darwin ru_maxrss bytes; Linux units known but Linux campaign execution prohibited
profile_metrics: Separate instrumented process records; never included in product timing/RSS summaries.
product_phase_metrics: Optional execution probe sidecar: preparation_ms, execution_ms, total_ms from three Instant boundaries outside operation loops. Remove stale sidecar before invocation; parse after wait4 and product clock stop. Require matching status and finite nonnegative required metrics; preserve raw JSON/hash. Phase summaries report median/min/max and null/not-claimed p95. Ordinary xsh invocation wall/RSS rows remain separate.
filesystem_cache: May be warm; no cache flushing is performed or claimed.
timeout: Per-workload positive seconds, process group SIGKILL followed by direct-child wait4 reap.
output: Exact stdout/stderr bytes stored outside the timed region and SHA-256 fingerprints retained in every process record. Native expected observations are explicit manifest values.
